name: migration-marketplace
description: Local marketplace for web migration/modernization plugins.

plugins.name: claude-migration-skills
plugins.description: Web migration/modernization skills for Dockerized, Makefile-driven projects: lando-to-docker sets up the Docker Compose + Makefile dev environment the others depend on; an orchestrated Drupal 10 → 11 upgrade (d11) delegating to php-docker-upgrade, php-deprecations-audit and jquery-4-migration (each usable standalone); the Gulp → Vite front build migration (gulp-to-vite); SCSS modernization with sass-migrator (sass-migrator); and a PHP_CodeSniffer setup/cleanup pass (phpcs-standards).
